items.name: 조사관 수첩
items.prompt: Edit this existing notebook icon with one targeted technical correction: preserve the notebook design, materials, colors, angle and all visible details. Clean the transparent area around it so there are no nearly invisible residual pixels or haze. Keep the entire notebook within the central 60% of the square canvas with at least 20% fully transparent padding on every edge. Strict hard pixel sprite edges and binary alpha: only fully opaque object pixels and fully transparent background pixels. No added object, no writing, no new ornament.

items.name: 영혼석
items.prompt: Edit the supplied game icon to create a separate matching sprite. Preserve the square transparent canvas, strict chunky pixel-art language, dark stepped outlines, muted charcoal/dead-brown/parchment/matte-bronze palette, simple top-left light, and small-icon readability. This is for a consistent 16-bit dark-folklore investigation game UI set, not a realistic painting. The whole new foreground must fit inside the central 60% of the canvas, leaving a fully empty transparent 20% border on every side. Use hard crisp pixel edges; background must have alpha zero with no stray faint pixels, aura, haze, anti-aliased shadow, checkerboard, backdrop, text, watermark, rune, skull, face, gear or pipe. One icon only. Replace the notebook entirely with one rough, irregular soulstone: a small jagged chunk of dark gray stone with two pale muted-teal mineral fissures and a restrained inner teal glint. Clearly uncut, asymmetrical and stone-like; no human shapes or ghost face. Retain the same chunky square pixel density and reserved material shading. This is the game's ordinary soulstone currency icon.

items.name: 핵심 단서
items.prompt: Edit this existing pixel-art UI icon into a matching new system icon. Preserve its square transparent canvas and consistent dark chunky pixel outlines, limited charcoal, worn-brown, aged-ivory, matte-bronze and tiny muted-teal palette. Keep a strict 16-bit sprite look with crisp square pixel clusters and simple top-left highlights. Replace the notebook completely. One isolated foreground icon, centered and wholly within the central 60% of the canvas; the outer 20% on every side must be fully transparent alpha zero. No background, shadow outside the object, halo, barely-visible stray pixels, checkerboard, word, letter, number, logo or watermark. No gears, pipes, machinery, faces, skulls or magical runes. Readable at 64 and 32 pixels. Subject: a compact investigation evidence icon, a simple matte-bronze magnifying glass with a short worn dark-wood handle laid diagonally across one small folded, torn-edged ivory evidence paper. The paper must be blank, with no writing or stamps. Clear silhouette of round lens plus folded paper, no extra objects. The lens has a restrained slate-teal reflection, not a luminous magical effect. Match the source icon's material texture and pixel density.
